instruction: Change the color of titles in slides 3, 4, and 5 to red

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing title color in slides 3, 4, and 5 (0-indexed as 2, 3, 4) to red RGB(255, 0, 0). Evaluator extracts RGB color from title text runs and compares against target. Partial credit given for each correctly colored slide (1/3 per slide).

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all 3 required slides (slides 3, 4, 5 mapped to 0-indexed 2, 3, 4)
Getter extracts RGB color from title text runs using python-pptx library correctly
Metric compares actual RGB color against expected red RGB(255, 0, 0) with proper equality check
Postconfig appropriately saves the file (Ctrl+S) to persist changes before verification
Partial credit logic is sound: awards 1/3 point per correctly colored slide
Edge cases handled: missing slides, slides without titles, empty text runs

Minor limitation: Getter only checks first non-empty text run in title. If title has multiple runs with different colors, only first run is verified. However, this is acceptable because typical title color changes apply to entire title uniformly.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider iterating through ALL text runs in a title to verify they all have the target color, not just the first non-empty run. This would catch cases where titles are partially colored.
Add explicit handling or documentation for edge case where title text spans multiple runs with different formatting.
